SYSTEM_WRAPPER.system_type: PhotoKit, AVFoundation, Vision, CoreNFC, URLProtocol or Operation framework object
SYSTEM_WRAPPER.protection: The wrapper owns only the framework object crossing the callback boundary; mutable state stays local to the framework queue or an explicit lock.
SYSTEM_WRAPPER.replacement_plan: Replace the wrapper with a framework snapshot or actor-backed adapter when the minimum deployment and SDK APIs allow it.

LOCK_PROTECTED.system_type: Reference type with shared transport, cache, socket or speech state
LOCK_PROTECTED.protection: Every mutable field crossing an isolation boundary is accessed through the type's lock or serial queue.
LOCK_PROTECTED.replacement_plan: Move shared state to an actor or an immutable instance configuration during the 5.x migration window.

LEGACY_MODEL.system_type: Existing public reference model or third-party data-source class
LEGACY_MODEL.protection: The object remains on its existing owner/actor; only immutable snapshots cross an isolation boundary.
LEGACY_MODEL.replacement_plan: Add a Sendable value snapshot and migrate new APIs before removing the reference model in 6.0.

MAIN_ACTOR_ONLY.system_type: UIKit, debug UI, lifecycle, metric or proxy object
MAIN_ACTOR_ONLY.protection: Creation, mutation and callbacks are confined to MainActor; background work returns values only.
MAIN_ACTOR_ONLY.replacement_plan: Keep UI state MainActor-isolated and remove the compatibility marker after all callbacks are actor-aware.

TEMPORARY.protection: No new usage is allowed; the existing call path is isolated and documented before use.
TEMPORARY.replacement_plan: Assign a concrete system, lock, model or MainActor category before the next release.
